newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks edge up at close, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks edge up at close, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks edged up at Monday's close, wiping out losses in early trade as individuals squared positions on clearing day, dealers said.
They said there was little genuine buying and the market could open weaker on Tuesday on fears of sectarian unrest after the killing of 21 people in a mosque in the city of Multan.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 3.46 points, or 0.24 percent, to end at 1,418.42. Losers led gainers 147 to 88. Turnover fell to 16 million shares from 21 million in the previous session.

Faysal Bank fell 1.10 rupees to 22 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.20 to 22.50. Hub Power rose 0.95 to 33.75 and Shell Pakistan 4.50 to 132. Pakistan State Oil fell 1.0 to 335. PTCL fell 0.65 to 34.20. Fauji Fertilizer rose 2.10 to 69.70.
